<a id="sfx_period_lo_init"></a>
### [`sfx_period_lo_init`](../../../../src/sfx/sfx_period_tables.asm#L103) `$C700-$C7FF`

*data*

Low bytes of the CIA1 timer B count for each sample byte value. init_game_state copies them to sfx_period_lo ($18fa) before shape buffer 3 overwrites them.

- **Read by:** [`init_game_state`](../game/init_machine.md#init_game_state)
- **Entry of:** [`shape_buffer_lo`](../../tables.md#shape_buffer_lo)

<a id="sfx_period_hi_init"></a>
### [`sfx_period_hi_init`](../../../../src/sfx/sfx_period_tables.asm#L121) `$C800-$C8FF`

*data*

High bytes of the timer B count, copied to sfx_period_hi ($1900). The counts rise from 1 (value 0) to 60000 (value $ff); the samples use values $04-$f1.

- **Read by:** [`init_game_state`](../game/init_machine.md#init_game_state)
